name: חיסור שני שברים – מכנה אחד כפולה של השני (באנגלית)

functions.name: igcd2
functions.body: if q=0 then abs(p) else igcd2(q,mod(p,q))

questiontext:
Express the following, as a single fraction:

\[ {{CT:0}}-{{CT:1}}. \]

Leave your answer in its lowest terms in the form \(\frac{a}{b}\).

[[input:ans]]
[[validation:ans]]
generalfeedback:
Outline: Rewrite both fractions over the lowest common denominator, subtract the numerators, then cancel any common factor.
Step 1 — The lowest common denominator
The first task in subtracting fractions is to rewrite each as an equivalent fraction with the same denominators. You can guarantee this by multiplying the two denominators together or find the Lowest Common Multiple (LCM).
In this case the second denominator is a multiple of the first, so the lowest common multiple of {{CT:2}} and {{CT:3}} is \({{CT:4}}\). Prime factorisations: \({{CT:5}}={{CT:6}}\) and \({{CT:7}}={{CT:8}}\); the LCM takes every prime with its highest power.
Step 2 — Equivalent fractions with the same denominator

Next re-write the expression in the form:

\[ \frac{a}{{CT:4}}-\frac{b}{{CT:4}}. \]

To convert a fraction to an equivalent form we must multiply the denominator and numerator by the same number. In this case, there is nothing to do with the second fraction so we multiply the numerator of the first fraction by \({{CT:9}}\). We obtain:

\[ {{CT:0}}-{{CT:1}} = \frac{{CT:10}}{{CT:11}}-{{CT:1}} = \frac{{CT:12}}{{CT:4}}-\frac{{CT:13}}{{CT:4}} = \frac{{CT:14}}{{CT:4}}. \]

Step 3 — Lowest terms
We may need to cancel any common factors in the numerator and denominator to obtain the answer in lowest terms \({{CT:15}}\). The greatest common divisor of the numerator and the denominator is \(\gcd({{CT:16}},{{CT:4}})={{CT:17}}\).[[if test="{{CT:21}}"]] Cancel this common factor:

\[ \frac{{{CT:18}}}{{{CT:4}}}=\frac{{{CT:19}}\cdot {{CT:17}}}{{{CT:20}}\cdot {{CT:17}}}={{CT:15}} \]

Now the numerator and the denominator have no common factor other than 1, so the answer is in lowest terms:[[else]] So nothing cancels: the fraction is already in lowest terms:[[/if]]

\[ {{CT:0}}-{{CT:1}}={{CT:15}} \]

on_true.feedback: Remember that the first step in subtracting fractions is to make both denominators equal. It is not simply subtracting the numerators and the denominators.
Simplify the fraction fully into the form \(\frac{a}{b}\) and leave in its lowest terms.
